Luxury 5-Bedroom Villa | Polo Community | Private Pool | Fully Furnished

Experience refined living in this exceptional 5-bedroom villa located in Al Habtoor Polo Resort and Club – The Residences, a prestigious address offering a unique blend of tranquility, elegance, and equestrian charm.

Set on a spacious plot of 6,525.40 sqft, this villa is thoughtfully designed to deliver both comfort and sophistication, making it an ideal home for families seeking a premium lifestyle in a serene polo community.

Property Features:

5 Spacious Bedrooms
7 Modern Bathrooms
Elegant interiors with premium marble flooring
Fully furnished with high-quality finishes
Fully equipped kitchen with modern appliances
Generous storage room
Private swimming pool with direct access to polo fields
2 covered parking spaces + 2 outdoor parking spaces

This stunning home offers seamless indoor-outdoor living, with beautifully designed spaces that open up to breathtaking polo field views. The private pool area creates a perfect setting for relaxation and entertaining.

Community Highlights:

Exclusive polo and equestrian lifestyle
Lush green landscapes and open spaces
Access to world-class leisure and dining facilities
Peaceful and family-friendly environment
Easy connectivity to key areas in Dubai

Live in a one-of-a-kind community where luxury meets nature and sport. This villa is a rare opportunity to enjoy upscale living in one of Dubai’s most distinctive residential destinations.

Contact us today to arrange a private viewing.
